recruiterCard.summary: Delivered high-volume STEM instruction while using progress data and individualized plans to improve student outcomes over multiple years.
impactBullets: Delivered 1,500+ hours of STEM instruction, increasing average student assessment performance by 40%.
Used data-driven learning plans to track progress and optimize individualized instruction strategies.
Led with clear communication, consistency, and measurable student support rather than one-size-fits-all teaching.
